observations: Canonical approval and exact purpose, self-signing, process OS session and fixed paths precede Keychain/ledger access; consumed qualification precedes CKContainer construction.
ProductionAttemptLatch has no reset and is consumed before first persistent production attempt, fencing same-process entry reuse. Invalid input rejects before the latch and state are consumed.

Application Support inspection is read-only. Enrollment may create one selected leaf beneath an existing held parent, with fsync and no-follow inode checks; no recursive ancestor creation or existing-state repair.
Parent/leaf symlinks and regular-file replacement reject; existing input bytes/inode remain unchanged.
CLI fatal exits nonzero; callbacks cannot be observed after process termination. Outer stdout report is explicitly derived, not ledger-anchored, and references inner observation hash.

OS session proves process membership in a graphical local security session, not current foreground console user or intended iCloud identity. Owner test-session confirmation and actual account qualification remain mandatory.
limitations: Only pure OS policy, synthetic directories and malformed-input rejection executed. No production enrollment/run, CKContainer, account API or real Keychain access.
Actual signed sandbox OS-session/sysctl/Application Support qualification is a separate root-owned offline verification; these six tests do not establish it.
No broad regression repeated; retained ledger/runner/runtime independent evidence is separate.
